table.name: SEC filing financial disclosure facts
table.purpose: One row per reported XBRL fact (disclosure instance) extracted from US SEC 10-K and 10-Q filings. Each row records a single monetary value for a US-GAAP taxonomy element (e.g., CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue, StockholdersEquity, Goodwill, DebtCurrent) as of a specific reporting date, along with the filing context, unit, and taxonomy version. It is referenced by topic tables such as CASHANDCASHEQUIVALENTS, DEBT, GOODWILL, ACCOUNTSPAYABLEANDACCRUEDLIABILITIES, and LONGTERMDEBT, which appear to be views/subsets of these facts by element.

APPLICABLEPERIOD.name: applicable period type
APPLICABLEPERIOD.description: Whether the reported fact applies to an instant (point in time) or a duration. All rows are 'instant', i.e. balance-sheet-style point-in-time measures.

DISCLOSUREID.name: disclosure fact ID
DISCLOSUREID.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each reported disclosure fact. One-to-one with ELEMENTSOFFINANCIALREPORT.ELEMENTSOFFINANCIALREPORTID, suggesting the fact and its element record share an ID.

HASDOCUMENTTYPE.name: SEC filing type
HASDOCUMENTTYPE.description: The SEC filing form type the fact was reported in: '10-Q' (quarterly report) or '10-K' (annual report).

HASMETRICCONTEXTDIMENSIONS.name: XBRL context / source document
HASMETRICCONTEXTDIMENSIONS.description: Filename of the XBRL instance document (e.g., 'ssi-20140802.xml', 'pvh-20180204.xml') from which the fact was extracted; typically the filer ticker plus period end date. Identifies the reporting entity and context.

HASMETRICENDDATE.name: period end date
HASMETRICENDDATE.description: End date of the reporting period, as YYYYMMDD (e.g., 20140731). For instant facts this is the as-of date.

HASMETRICENDQUARTER.name: period end quarter
HASMETRICENDQUARTER.description: Calendar quarter (Q1-Q4) in which the period end date falls.

HASMETRICSTARTDATE.name: period start date
HASMETRICSTARTDATE.description: Start date of the reporting period, as YYYYMMDD. Identical to the end date in all sampled rows, consistent with instant (point-in-time) facts.

HASMETRICSTARTQUARTER.name: period start quarter
HASMETRICSTARTQUARTER.description: Calendar quarter (Q1-Q4) in which the period start date falls; equals the end quarter for instant facts.

HASMETRICVALUE.name: reported value
HASMETRICVALUE.description: The reported monetary amount in the unit given by HASUNIT, stored in scientific notation (e.g., +2.6094E+007 = 26,094,000). Ranges from about -13.6 billion to 419 billion, consistent with corporate balance-sheet amounts.

HASMETRICYEARCALENDAR.name: calendar year
HASMETRICYEARCALENDAR.description: Calendar year of the reporting period end date (2012-2019).

HASMETRICYEARFISCAL.name: fiscal year
HASMETRICYEARFISCAL.description: Fiscal year of the reporting period as designated by the filer (2012-2020); can differ from the calendar year for filers with non-calendar fiscal years (e.g., end date 20190930 has fiscal year 2020).

HASUNIQUEIDENTIFIER.name: XBRL element identifier
HASUNIQUEIDENTIFIER.description: US-GAAP taxonomy element name prefixed with the taxonomy year, e.g., 'us-gaap/2014_CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue'. Identifies which financial statement line item the value represents.

HASUNIT.name: currency unit
HASUNIT.description: Currency of the reported value: USD (overwhelmingly), with a few CAD, EUR, and AUD facts.

HASURL.name: taxonomy namespace URL
HASURL.description: URL of the US-GAAP taxonomy version used for the element (e.g., http://fasb.org/us-gaap/2014); matches the year in HASUNIQUEIDENTIFIER.

ISCOMPUTED.name: is computed flag
ISCOMPUTED.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the value was computed/derived rather than directly reported. All rows are 'false', i.e., values as reported in the filing.

HASNAME.name: element name
HASNAME.description: The XBRL element name; constant value 'EarningsPerShareBasic' in all rows, so this table holds basic EPS element instances rather than dividend distributions.

table.name: ELEMENTOFFINANCIALSTATEMENT
table.purpose: Facts extracted from SEC filings (10-K/10-Q XBRL data): one row per reported financial statement element (e.g. NetIncomeLoss, AssetsCurrent) with its value, period, unit, and US-GAAP taxonomy reference. It is the fact table that specialized element tables (ASSET, REVENUE, EXPENSE, etc.) reference one-to-one via shared IDs.

APPLICABLEPERIOD.name: Period type
APPLICABLEPERIOD.description: Nature of the reported period: 'instant' for balance-sheet (point-in-time) values, 'quarterly' for a quarter's flow, 'yearly' for a full-year flow.

ELEMENTOFFINANCIALSTATEMENTID.name: Element of financial statement ID
ELEMENTOFFINANCIALSTATEMENTID.description: Primary key; also serves as the ID in child element tables (ASSET, REVENUE, EXPENSE, COMPREHENSIVEINCOME, DISTRIBUTIONTOOWNER, etc.) via one-to-one joins.

HASDOCUMENTTYPE.name: SEC filing type
HASDOCUMENTTYPE.description: The SEC form the fact was reported in: '10-Q' (quarterly report) or '10-K' (annual report).

HASMETRICCONTEXTDIMENSIONS.name: XBRL context / source document
HASMETRICCONTEXTDIMENSIONS.description: Name of the XBRL instance document (e.g. orcl-20160831.xml) the fact came from; effectively identifies the filing/context, including dimensional qualifiers.

HASMETRICENDDATE.name: Period end date
HASMETRICENDDATE.description: End date of the reporting period as YYYYMMDD (instant dates for balance-sheet items, period end for flows).

HASMETRICENDQUARTER.name: End quarter
HASMETRICENDQUARTER.description: Calendar quarter (Q1-Q4) containing the period end date.

HASMETRICSTARTDATE.name: Period start date
HASMETRICSTARTDATE.description: Start date of the reporting period as YYYYMMDD; equals the end date for instant (balance-sheet) facts.

HASMETRICSTARTQUARTER.name: Start quarter
HASMETRICSTARTQUARTER.description: Calendar quarter (Q1-Q4) containing the period start date.

HASMETRICVALUE.name: Reported value
HASMETRICVALUE.description: The numeric value of the element in the stated unit (USD/CAD), stored in scientific-notation string form; can be negative (e.g. losses).

HASMETRICYEARCALENDAR.name: Calendar year
HASMETRICYEARCALENDAR.description: Calendar year (2012-2019) of the reporting period.

HASMETRICYEARFISCAL.name: Fiscal year
HASMETRICYEARFISCAL.description: Fiscal year label of the reporting period; can differ from the calendar year (e.g. Oracle's fiscal 2017 in calendar 2016).

HASUNIQUEIDENTIFIER.name: US-GAAP element identifier
HASUNIQUEIDENTIFIER.description: Taxonomy-year plus element name, e.g. 'us-gaap/2016_NetIncomeLoss', identifying which US-GAAP concept the fact reports.

HASUNIT.name: Currency unit
HASUNIT.description: Currency of the reported value: USD (overwhelmingly) or CAD.

HASURL.name: Taxonomy namespace URL
HASURL.description: URL of the US-GAAP taxonomy version (e.g. http://fasb.org/us-gaap/2016) used to define the element.

ISCOMPUTED.name: Is computed
ISCOMPUTED.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the value was derived/computed rather than directly reported in the filing (note: 'true' values carry a trailing space).

table.name: HOLDING
table.purpose: Records individual security holdings: a quantity of a specific security held in a financial service account (e.g., a brokerage account), with a short description naming the stock ticker. Each row is one holding position in one account. The REFERSTO id matches SECURITY/LISTEDSECURITY/FINANCIALINSTRUMENT ids (1001000-1005649 range) and ISHELDBY matches FINANCIALSERVICEACCOUNT ids (150000000000 range). The HASDESCRIPTION values like 'Stock AVGO', 'Stock GOOGL' are US stock tickers, so the referenced securities are listed equity securities. HASCOUNT is a fractional quantity (shares held, possibly a synthetic/scaled value).

HASCOUNT.description: Number of units (shares) of the security held in the account. Fractional values (20.0 to ~3001, mean ~1510) suggest a synthetic or scaled share count rather than an actual position size; no currency/unit evidence beyond a count.
